requirements.requirement: The system must expose a facade method in evaluate_care_facade that accepts a comparison request containing two or more provider identifiers.
The system must validate that the comparison request conforms to the schema defined in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-001 before processing.
The system must invoke the provider comparison engine implemented in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-002 from the facade layer.
The system must return a structured comparison response matching the schema defined in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-001.
The system must register a tool endpoint in tool_router that maps to the comparison facade method.
The system must expose the comparison tool with a unique and descriptive tool name consistent with existing tool_router patterns.
The system must ensure the tool endpoint accepts structured arguments compatible with LLM tool invocation (JSON-serializable input).
The system must ensure the tool endpoint returns JSON-serializable structured output suitable for LLM consumption.
The system must include ranked providers in the response ordered by comparison score.
The system must include per-provider quality scores and measure breakdowns in the response.
The system must include relative strengths and weaknesses for each provider in the response.
The system must return an error response when fewer than two providers are supplied in the request.
The system must return an error response when the input schema validation fails.
The system must propagate and surface comparison engine failures as structured error responses through the facade.
The system must ensure the tool_router exposes the comparison capability without requiring direct access to internal services.
The system must ensure the comparison tool description provides sufficient semantic guidance for LLM selection among tools.
The system must ensure the comparison tool description explicitly states that it compares multiple providers and returns ranked results.
The system must ensure the tool supports variable-length provider lists (two or more) without requiring fixed input size.
The system must ensure that identical provider IDs in the request are either deduplicated or rejected with a clear error.
The system must ensure the response includes provider identifiers to allow downstream systems to map results correctly.
The system must ensure the tool_router registration follows the same pattern as existing tools in tool_router.py.
The system must ensure the facade method is accessible without requiring changes to unrelated facade endpoints.
